item.title: Winston Peters orders Crown company to pull six-figure job ads
item.description: After questions from The Post, the rail minister asked for a “please explain” over three roles with salaries up to $270,000.

item.title: Safer, smoother, quieter: New Zealand gets its first road made with rubber
item.description: Almost 1800 tyres were used to create the rubber section of road.

item.title: Massive AI factory to become New Zealand’s second-largest electricity user
item.description: Resource consent has been given for a data centre near Invercargill, which would become New Zealand’s second-highest electricity user.

item.title: NZ won’t be rushing to buy Russian oil as supply dwindles, Willis says
item.description: Finance Minister Nicola Willis says New Zealand has “ample” supply of fuel and won’t be rushing to buy unsanctioned Russian oil as the conflict in the Middle East upends global energy markets.

item.title: Wellington Phoenix star’s $135,000 surgery trip stalled by Middle East conflict
item.description: Sabitra “Samba” Bhandari has been unable to travel to Qatar for specialist surgery to repair her ruptured ACL despite crowd funding $135,000.

item.title: Fatal crash involving truck and pedestrian near Pukekohe
item.description: Police confirmed the male pedestrian died at the scene.

item.title: Watch: Giant Hurricanes lock seals win with charge-down try as bench turns game
item.description: The Hurricanes overpowered the Western Force 31-23 in Napier on Friday night to notch back-to-back wins against Australian sides and move top of the Super Rugby Pacific standings.

item.title: Canterbury residents warned off consuming shellfish due to 'extremely high' toxin levels
item.description: People are being urged not to eat shellfish collected from the sea at Banks Peninsula.

item.title: Liam Lawson’s troublesome start issues return, misses out on SQ3
item.description: Both Racing Bulls were knocked out in SQ2 as George Russell and Kimi Antonelli completed a front row lockout for Mercedes.

item.title: Watch: Injury-depleted Warriors turn on seven tries against Raiders
item.description: It was Roger Tuivasa-Sheck’s night, but Leka Halasima did his best to steal the milestone man’s thunder in a massive second-half performance.
